design_detail: Recurring parliamentary Finance Bill amendments by Workers' Party deputies to institute an annual Impôt sur la fortune (ISF)
quote_original: Les députés du PT ont proposé durant des années l’institution d’un impôt sur la fortune. Mais à chaque Loi de finances, cette proposition était malheureusement rejetée par la majorité des députés du FLN et du RND
quote_en: PT deputies have proposed for years the institution of a wealth tax. But at every Finance Law, this proposal was unfortunately rejected by the majority of FLN and RND deputies
source_title: Instauration de l’impôt sur la fortune : le PT se réjouit
grading_note: Grade A: Direct statement by PT spokesperson Ramdane Taazibt confirming the party's recurring formal Finance Bill amendments to establish an Impôt sur la fortune.

design_detail: Formal parliamentary amendment to the 2019 Finance Bill (PLF 2019) proposing the introduction of an Impôt sur la fortune
quote_original: La proposition qui a été introduite par les représentants du parti des travailleurs, stipulant l’introduction d’un impôt sur la fortune a été rejetée par la commission des finances au niveau de l’APN ainsi que par la majorité des députés lors du vote de la loi de finance de 2019.
quote_en: The proposal introduced by the representatives of the Workers' Party, stipulating the introduction of a wealth tax, was rejected by the Finance Committee at the APN as well as by the majority of deputies during the vote on the 2019 Finance Law.
source_title: Enième rejet de l’impôt sur la fortune par le parlement
grading_note: Grade A: Formal legislative amendment tabled by the Workers' Party parliamentary group on the 2019 Finance Bill.

design_detail: Endorsement of the Impôt sur la fortune (50M DZD threshold, 1%–3.5% progressive rates) in PLF 2018 as a core struggle of the Workers' Party
quote_original: قالت الأمينة العامة لحزب العمال لويزة حنون أن الضريبة المفروضة مؤخرا على الثروة ورجال الأعمال كانا محور نضال حزبها طيلة السنوات الفارطة ، حيث أضافت في هذا الشأن أن هذا القرار الذي إتخذته وزارة عبد الرحمان راوية يستحق التثمين .
quote_en: Workers' Party Secretary General Louisa Hanoune said that the tax recently imposed on wealth and businessmen had been the axis of her party's struggle throughout the past years, adding in this regard that this decision taken by Abderrahmane Raouya's ministry deserves appreciation.
source_title: حنون تثمن قرار راوية بفرض الضريبة على الثروة
grading_note: Grade B: Named public speech endorsing the wealth tax, reported in third-person narration.

design_detail: Condemnation of the APN Finance Committee's withdrawal of the Impôt sur la fortune from PLF 2018
quote_original: واتهم «حزب العمال» اليساري، الذي تقوده مرشحة انتخابات الرئاسة سابقاً لويزة حنون، برلمانيي «جبهة التحرير الوطني» و«التجمع الوطني الديمقراطي» (أغلبية كبيرة في غرفتي البرلمان) بـ«اتخاذ موقف ضد مصلحة الشعب» عندما وضعوا كل ثقلهم في «اللجنة القانونية للمجلس الشعبي الوطني» (الغرفة الأولى) لإلغاء الضريبة على الثروة، قبل 48 ساعة من المصادقة على قانون الموازنة الجديد.
quote_en: The left-wing Workers' Party, led by former presidential candidate Louisa Hanoune, accused parliamentarians of the FLN and RND (a large majority in both houses of Parliament) of 'taking a stance against the interest of the people' when they threw all their weight in the committee of the People's National Assembly to cancel the wealth tax, 48 hours before the adoption of the new budget law.
source_title: الجزائر: انتقادات غاضبة لإلغاء «ضريبة الثروة»
grading_note: Grade B: Named reaction condemning the removal of the wealth tax from the 2018 Finance Bill.

design_detail: Defense of the Impôt sur la fortune in PLF 2018 and condemnation of its suppression by the APN Finance Committee
quote_original: «Le puissant lobby des hommes d’affaires, présents à l’APN et dans la sphère du pouvoir, fait tomber l’impôt sur la fortune, pourtant d’une banalité incroyable, proposé par le gouvernement»
quote_en: 'The powerful lobby of businessmen, present in the APN and in the sphere of power, brings down the wealth tax—though of incredible banality—proposed by the government'
source_title: Impôt sur la fortune : le PT dénonce «un coup de force»
grading_note: Grade B: Verbatim direct quote defending the wealth tax and denouncing its suppression by business lobbies.

design_detail: Call during APN debate on the Government Action Plan to replace austerity measures with the institution of a wealth tax
quote_original: Ce changement peut être opéré, a-t-il ajouté, à travers la révision de la politique fiscale, le rétablissement de l'autorité de l'Etat concernant le commerce extérieur, la suppression des mesures actuelles d'austérité contre l'institution d'un impôt sur la fortune, le suivi juridique des transactions suspectes et la lutte contre toute forme de corruption.
quote_en: This change can be achieved, he added, through the revision of tax policy, the restoration of State authority over foreign trade, the abolition of current austerity measures in exchange for the institution of a wealth tax, legal monitoring of suspicious transactions, and the fight against all forms of corruption.
source_title: Conjoncture économique: Des députés pour la diversification de la production hors hydrocarbures
grading_note: Grade B: Parliamentary floor speech calling for the institution of an impôt sur la fortune.

design_detail: Formal parliamentary amendment to the 2014 Finance Bill (PLF 2014) proposing the introduction of a net wealth tax to replace the uncollected 1993 property tax
quote_original: رفضت لجنة المالية والميزانية إدراج مقترح فرض ضريبة على الثروة، واعتبرت أن النظام الجبائي الحالي يتضمن ضريبة على الأملاك الخاصة تطبق على الأشخاص الطبيعيين الذين لديهم موطنا جبائيا بالجزائر، وهو الرد الذي لم يستسغه صاحب المقترح النائب اسماعيل قوادرية الذي قال بأن الضريبة على الملكية لا تعد سوى حبر على ورق
quote_en: The Finance and Budget Committee refused to include a proposal to impose a wealth tax, considering that the current tax system includes a tax on private property applied to natural persons domiciled for tax purposes in Algeria—a response rejected by the sponsor of the proposal, Deputy Smaïl Kouadria, who said that the property tax is nothing more than ink on paper.
source_title: البرلمان يُفرمل القروض الاستهلاكية ويرفض ضريبة الثروة
grading_note: Grade A: Formal sponsorship of a parliamentary Finance Bill amendment introducing a wealth tax.

design_detail: 2024 FFS presidential programme 'Vision pour demain': institution and enforcement of an individual net wealth tax on total patrimonio, decentralized to municipalities (APCs)
quote_original: Depuis Alger où il était l’hôte du forum du quotidien national d’El-Moudjahid, le candidat à la présidentielle du Front des forces socialistes (FFS), Youcef Aouchiche s’est dit engagé dans l’instauration et l’application de l’impôt sur la fortune en Algérie, où chaque Algérien est soumis à payer sa part de contribution fiscale à l’État selon la valeur de ses biens et dans le cadre d’un cadre juridique fiscal loyal pour tout le monde.
quote_en: From Algiers, where he was the guest of the national daily El-Moudjahid's forum, the presidential candidate of the Socialist Forces Front (FFS), Youcef Aouchiche, declared his commitment to instituting and enforcing the wealth tax in Algeria, where every Algerian is required to pay their share of tax contribution to the State according to the value of their assets.
source_title: Le candidat du FFS affiche ses ambitions hier à Alger : «J’instaurerais et j’appliquerais l’impôt sur la fortune»
grading_note: Grade A: Official party presidential election platform ('Vision pour demain') committing to institute and enforce an individual net wealth tax.

design_detail: Presidential platform 'Vision pour demain': individual net wealth tax assessed on the value of assets (patrimoine) with municipal decentralization to APCs
quote_original: Et pour remédier à cette situation, le candidat à la présidentielle du septembre prochain a promis, au cas de son élection à la tête de l’État, de créer une décentralisation municipale de l’impôt sur la fortune, « elle sera mise en place dès que nous arrivons au pouvoir », s’est engagé le jeune candidat des Forces socialistes.
quote_en: And to remedy this situation, the candidate in next September's presidential election promised, if elected head of State, to create a municipal decentralization of the wealth tax: 'it will be put in place as soon as we come to power', pledged the young candidate of the Socialist Forces.
source_title: Le candidat du FFS affiche ses ambitions hier à Alger : «J’instaurerais et j’appliquerais l’impôt sur la fortune»
grading_note: Grade A: Direct verbatim pledge in presidential platform 'Vision pour demain' specifying an individual net wealth tax on patrimonio with municipal decentralization.

design_detail: Opposition in the APN to the deletion of Article 12 (Impôt sur la fortune) from the 2018 Finance Bill
quote_original: وكانت لحظة عرض السعيد بوحجة، رئيس المجلس الشعبي الوطني نص المادة 12 من مشروع القانون المتعلقة بالضريبة على الثروة، كفيلا بإندلاع مشادات كلامية بين الموالاة التي صوتت لصالح إلغائها بحجة صعوبة تطبيقها في الوقت الراهن والمعارضة التي ألحت على إبقائها.
quote_en: The moment Speaker Saïd Bouhadja presented the text of Article 12 of the bill relating to the wealth tax sparked heated exchanges between the pro-government majority, which voted to cancel it on the pretext of difficulty of implementation, and the opposition, which insisted on keeping it.
source_title: زيادات الوقود وضريبة الأثرياء تلغم البرلمان!
grading_note: Grade B: Parliamentary stance of MSP and fellow opposition groups insisting on retaining Article 12 (wealth tax) in PLF 2018.

design_detail: Condemnation of the APN Finance Committee's deletion of the Impôt sur la fortune from PLF 2018
quote_original: Dans la même veine, le président du MSP, Abdelmadjid Menasra, estimait hier que cette décision constituait « un alignement clair contre les pauvres » ajoutant qu’« il n’y a que les pauvres qui payent l’impôt en Algérie »
quote_en: In the same vein, the president of the MSP, Abdelmadjid Menasra, considered yesterday that this decision constituted 'a clear alignment against the poor', adding that 'only the poor pay tax in Algeria'.
source_title: L’impôt sur la fortune : projet improvisé et fiasco politique
grading_note: Grade B: Direct quoted statement by MSP President Abdelmadjid Menasra condemning the cancellation of the wealth tax.

design_detail: Defense of the PLF 2018 wealth tax targeting the rich against its withdrawal by the APN Finance Committee
quote_original: وتساءل حموش كيف يمكن أن يتأتى للجان المالية بالمجلس أن ترفض جميع التعديلات التي تقدمت بها المعارضة بهدف تجنيب الشعب الزيادات المقترحة من قبل الحكومة في الوقت الذي تقبل فيه سحب هذه الضريبة التي لا تستهدف سوى الأغنياء؟
quote_en: Hamdadouche asked how the Assembly's finance committees could reject all the amendments submitted by the opposition aimed at sparing the people the increases proposed by the government, while accepting the withdrawal of this tax that only targets the rich?
source_title: قراءة في مضامين بعض الصحف المغاربية لليوم
grading_note: Grade B: Named parliamentary statement defending the wealth tax on the rich and criticizing its withdrawal.

design_detail: Call for enforcing a percentage-based net wealth tax rather than symbolic flat fees during PLF 2020 debates
quote_original: هذه الضريبة أسقطت بإيعاز من السلطة لصعوبة تطبيقها واليوم يجب أن تطبق لكي يتقاسم الجزائريون أعباء سياسة التقشف
quote_en: This tax was dropped at the instigation of the authorities due to the difficulty of applying it, and today it must be applied so that Algerians share the burdens of the austerity policy.
source_title: الحكومة تفرض ضريبة الثروة دون إحصاء عدد الأثرياء!
grading_note: Grade B: Verbatim direct quote by Deputy Lakhdar Benkhellaf demanding the enforcement of a real percentage-based wealth tax.

design_detail: Support for the PLF 2018 wealth tax and condemnation of its cancellation under pressure from businessman-MPs
quote_original: قال الطاهر حبشي، القيادي بحركة النهضة الإسلامية التي تمثل أقلية في البرلمان، لـ«الشرق الأوسط» إن 130 رجل أعمال في البرلمان ينتمون إلى حزبي السلطة «مارسوا ضغوطاً كبيرة لإلغاء الضريبة على الثروة، وكانوا مدفوعين في ذلك من طرف الحكومة التي حاولت خداع المواطنين بأنها تعتزم التشدد ضد آلاف الأثرياء
quote_en: Tahar Habchi, a leader of the Islamic Ennahda Movement which represents a minority in Parliament, told Asharq Al-Awsat that 130 businessmen in Parliament belonging to the two ruling parties 'exerted heavy pressure to cancel the wealth tax, and were driven in this by the government which tried to deceive citizens into thinking it intended to get tough on thousands of wealthy people'.
source_title: الجزائر: انتقادات غاضبة لإلغاء «ضريبة الثروة»
grading_note: Grade B: Direct interview quote condemning the cancellation of the wealth tax in PLF 2018.

design_detail: Formal trade union demand for instituting a wealth tax (taxe sur la fortune) alongside lowering wage IRG on workers
quote_original: L’Union générale des travailleurs algériens (UGTA) a réclamé, ce mercredi, depuis Skikda une baisse de l’impôt sur le revenu global des travailleurs (IRG) et l’instauration d’une taxe sur la fortune.
quote_en: The General Union of Algerian Workers (UGTA) demanded, this Wednesday from Skikda, a reduction in the global income tax on workers (IRG) and the institution of a wealth tax.
source_title: UGTA : Labatcha réclame une baisse de l’impôt sur les salaires
grading_note: Grade B: Official union demand for the institution of a wealth tax (taxe sur la fortune).

design_detail: Call by UGTA Secretary General Salim Labatcha to establish taxes on wealth so the fiscal burden is shared equitably
quote_original: La charge de l’impôt doit être répartie équitablement par l’établissement notamment d’impôts sur la fortune, a estimé l’intervenant, en relevant que cette revendication a été exprimée en permanence par des parlementaires lors de l’examen des projets de lois de finances, mais a été toujours rejetée.
quote_en: The tax burden must be distributed equitably notably through the establishment of taxes on wealth, the speaker considered, noting that this demand has been permanently expressed by parliamentarians during the review of draft finance laws, but has always been rejected.
source_title: UGTA : Labatcha réclame une baisse de l’impôt sur les salaires
grading_note: Grade B: Named public speech by UGTA Secretary General Salim Labatcha calling for wealth taxation.

design_detail: Presidential directive to the Council of Ministers to accelerate fiscal and property digitization in order to census and tax fortunes under the Impôt sur la fortune
quote_original: l’accélération de la digitalisation du secteur fiscal et des biens appartenant à des individus dans tous les domaines pour recenser la fortune, au lieu d’une politique fiscale ne ciblant que les petits fonctionnaires et travailleurs
quote_en: the acceleration of the digitization of the tax sector and of assets belonging to individuals in all fields in order to census wealth, instead of a tax policy targeting only small civil servants and workers
source_title: Pouvoir d’achat, impôts : ce qu’a dit le Président Tebboune
grading_note: Grade A: Formal presidential directive in the Council of Ministers to census and enforce taxation on individual fortunes.

design_detail: Presidential instruction to enforce the Impôt sur la fortune after redefining its scope alongside lowering IRG on workers
quote_original: وجاءت قرارات الرئيس الجزائري خلال اجتماع مجلس الوزراء، حيث وجّه أيضاً بضرورة العمل على فرض الضريبة على الثروة بعد "إعادة تعريفها".
quote_en: The Algerian President's decisions came during a Council of Ministers meeting, where he also directed the necessity of working to impose the wealth tax after 'redefining it'.
source_title: الجزائر تتجه لفرض ضريبة على الثروة
grading_note: Grade A: Official Council of Ministers instruction by President Tebboune to enforce the redefined wealth tax.

design_detail: Introduction of the Impôt sur la fortune in the draft 2018 Finance Bill (1% to 3.5% progressive rate on net wealth above 50M DZD)
quote_original: Un impôt sur la fortune sera proposé dans l'avant-projet de Loi de finances 2018, a indiqué ce mercredi le premier ministre, Ahmed Ouyahia, en réponse aux préoccupations des membres du Conseil de la nation soulevées lors des débats sur le Programme d'action du gouvernement.
quote_en: A wealth tax will be proposed in the preliminary draft of the 2018 Finance Law, Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia indicated this Wednesday in response to the concerns of members of the Council of the Nation raised during debates on the Government Action Plan.
source_title: Un impôt sur la fortune dans l'avant-projet de Loi de finances 2018
grading_note: Grade A: Prime Minister's formal introduction of the Impôt sur la fortune in the 2018 Finance Bill.

design_detail: Enactment of the revamped Impôt sur la fortune in the 2020 Supplementary Finance Law (PLFC 2020) at 0.15% to 1% on net wealth exceeding 100M DZD
quote_original: propose le remplacement de l’impôt sur le patrimoine par l’impôt sur la fortune, avec élargissement du champ des personnes auxquels il sera imposé et l’augmentation de sa valeur selon un barème progressif.
quote_en: proposes the replacement of the patrimony tax by the wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune), with an expansion of the scope of persons on whom it will be levied and an increase of its value according to a progressive scale.
source_title: Impôt sur la fortune : ce que propose le PLFC 2020
grading_note: Grade A: Formal legislative reform presented by Finance Minister Abderrahmane Raouya in PLFC 2020 establishing the Impôt sur la fortune with a 0.15%–1% progressive schedule above 100M DZD.

design_detail: Ministerial directive to the General Directorate of Taxes (DGI) to enforce the Impôt sur la fortune (0.15%–1% above 100M DZD) and deploy digital cadastral cross-checking
quote_original: Dans ce sillage, le ministre a affirmé avoir ordonné à la directrice générale des impôts de faire de cette année, « celle de l’impôt sur la fortune », soulignant que « l’évasion et la fraude fiscales sont devenues un phénomène national à combattre ».
quote_en: In this vein, the minister stated that he had ordered the Director General of Taxes to make this year 'that of the wealth tax', emphasizing that 'tax evasion and fraud have become a national phenomenon to be fought'.
source_title: Laziz Faid : la fiscalité ordinaire doit couvrir les dépenses salariales à court terme
grading_note: Grade A: Official ministerial directive by Finance Minister Laaziz Faid enforcing the statutory Impôt sur la fortune.

design_detail: Inter-agency DGDN–DGI cadastral data-sharing protocol (CAD-Fisc) to calculate the tax base and enforce the Impôt sur la fortune (ISF)
quote_original: Dans une allocution prononcée à cette occasion, M. Faid a expliqué que «cet accord s'inscrit dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre des engagements du président de la République, relatifs à la numérisation du secteur financier, ainsi qu'en application des instructions du Premier ministre, visant à consacrer l'exploitation des données cadastrales comme référentiel pour l'établissement de la taxe foncière, de la taxe d'enlèvement des ordures ménagères (TEOM) et de l'impôt sur la fortune (ISF)».
quote_en: In an address delivered on this occasion, Mr. Faid explained that 'this agreement is part of the implementation of the commitments of the President of the Republic relating to the digitization of the financial sector, as well as in application of the instructions of the Prime Minister, aimed at establishing the use of cadastral data as a benchmark for assessing property tax, the household waste collection tax (TEOM), and the wealth tax (ISF)'.
source_title: Finances : signature d'un protocole d'accord entre la DGDN et la DGI
grading_note: Grade A: Formal administrative protocol presided over by Finance Minister Laaziz Faid to operationalize assessment of the Impôt sur la fortune.

design_detail: Article 25 reform of the Impôt sur la fortune lowering the threshold from 100M DZD to 80M DZD with progressive rates of 0.20% (80–120M), 0.30% (120–200M), 0.40% (200–300M), 0.50% (300–400M), and 1% (>400M DZD) plus 10%–25% late-filing penalties
quote_original: يقترح مشروع قانون المالية لسنة 2026 في مادته الـ 25 مراجعة نظام الضريبة على الثروة في الجزائر، من خلال خفض سقف الخضوع من 100 مليون دينار إلى 80 مليون دينار، في مسعى لتحسين مردودية هذه الضريبة، وفقا لعرض الأسباب.
quote_en: The draft Finance Law in its Article 25 proposes revising the wealth tax system in Algeria by lowering the liability threshold from 100 million dinars to 80 million dinars, in an effort to improve the yield of this tax, according to the explanatory memorandum.
source_title: مراجعة نظام الضريبة على الثروة
grading_note: Grade A: Official Government Finance Bill provision lowering the net wealth tax threshold to 80M DZD and revising the 0.20%–1% progressive rate table.

design_detail: APN Finance and Budget Committee report and amendment lowering the Impôt sur la fortune threshold from 100M DZD (10 billion centimes) to 80M DZD (8 billion centimes) and strengthening enforcement mechanisms
quote_original: اقترحت لجنة المالية والميزانية، بالمجلس الشعبي الوطني، فرض الضريبة على الثروة بداية من 8 مليار دج بدل 10 ملايير دج، مع إسقاط المادة التي تتعلق بالزيادات في أسعار الوقود "عند الاقتضاء"، لانعكاسها المباشر على ارتفاع أسعار السلع والخدمات
quote_en: The Finance and Budget Committee of the People's National Assembly proposed imposing the wealth tax starting from 8 billion centimes [80M DZD] instead of 10 billion centimes [100M DZD], while dropping the article relating to fuel price increases 'where applicable' due to its direct impact on rising prices of goods and services.
source_title: 14 تعديلا على مشروع قانون المالية ولا زيادة في أسعار الوقود
grading_note: Grade A: Formal legislative committee proposal specifying the 80M DZD (8 billion centimes) net wealth threshold.

design_detail: Support for a fair, transparent, and enforceable net wealth tax with a clearly defined threshold and effective asset census grounded in horizontal tax justice
quote_original: في المقابل، يعتقد أستاذ الاقتصاد بوزيان مهماه، في رده على سؤال حول أسباب عدم دفع أغنياء الجزائر للضريبة على الثروة، أن "الثروة هي ملكية ولا يمكن أخذ الملكية من أحد إلا بالحق، لذا ينبغي وضع قانون عادل وشفاف وقابل للتنفيذ"، مشدداً أن الخطوة تقتضي تحديد المفهوم بدقة وما المقصود بالثراء وما سقفه، مع تحديد آليات الإحصاء الفعال والشفاف للثروة.
quote_en: In contrast, economics professor Bouziane Mahmah believes, in response to a question on why Algeria's rich do not pay the wealth tax, that 'wealth is property and property cannot be taken except by right, so a fair, transparent, and enforceable law must be established', stressing that the step requires precisely defining the concept and threshold of wealth along with mechanisms for an effective and transparent census of wealth.
source_title: فرض الضريبة على الثروة في الجزائر يصطدم بصعوبات
grading_note: Grade B: Named interview advocating a fair, transparent, and enforceable wealth tax law.

design_detail: Support for enforcing and auditing the Impôt sur la fortune without exception while calibrating the liability threshold to 200M–300M DZD
quote_original: و في سياق ذي صلة أبرز المتحدث أن  الضريبة على الثروة هي ضريبة يعول عليها كثيرا لو تم تطبيقها بصفة حسنة وجيدة وهي موجودة في العديد من الدول وليس في الجزائر فقط، ودعا سلامي إلى ضرورة رفع معدل الخضوع للضريبة من 100 مليون دينار جزائري إلى 200 أو 300 مليون دينار جزائري لأن 100 مليون دينار جزائري بالنسبة للكثير لاتعتبر ثروة لأن ربما مسكن محترم في بعض مناطق العاصمة يتجاوز هذا المبلغ،  وبالتالي قال الخبير في الشأن الإقتصادي وجب رفع هذا المبلغ حيث تبقى معدلاتها مقبولة إلا أنها ضعيفة على كل حال- حسبه-  مطالبا بضرورة  أن تكون هناك عدالة في تطبيق هذه الضريبة على كل أصحاب الثروة ممن تتوفر فيهم الشروط دون إستثناء.
quote_en: In a related context, the speaker highlighted that the wealth tax is a tax that can be heavily relied upon if applied properly and well, and exists in many countries not only Algeria; Sellami called for raising the liability threshold from 100 million DZD to 200 or 300 million DZD because 100 million DZD is not considered a fortune for many as a decent home in some areas of the capital exceeds that amount, while its rates remain acceptable though low, demanding justice in applying this tax to all qualifying wealth holders without exception.
source_title: فرض الضريبة على الثروة سنة 2023.. أصحاب الشكارة تحت المجهر
grading_note: Grade B: Named interview endorsing the wealth tax and specifying a 200M–300M DZD threshold, reported in third-person narration.
